out=[r[:] for r in g]

for i in [0,3,6]:

    for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:]):
        for j in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=2

    inds=[i for i in range(len(g)) if g[i][j]==4]
    for a,b in zip(inds,inds[1:]):
        for i in range(a+1,b): out[i][j]=2
